name: header-menu-click-toggle
title: Header 菜单改为点击切换
description: Replace hover/focus-driven AppBar expansion with explicit click-to-toggle behavior while preserving keyboard, outside-dismiss and mobile contracts.
scope: react-designer AppBar menu interaction and regression tests
creator: ROYIANS
notes: Desktop AppBar menus now ignore hover/focus and use explicit click toggling. The AppBar is an editor-interactive boundary so Designer root focus capture cannot close then reopen a menu during the same click. Outside pointer, focus leave, Escape, keyboard category navigation and mobile behavior are preserved. React Designer passes 111 tests, typecheck, focused ESLint and package build; real-browser QA covers desktop hover/open/close/switch/outside/Escape plus 480px mobile open/switch/close.
